content.text: In Cameroon, traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-works-how|payment]] gateways often fail digital creators, leaving them unable to sell their products effectively. With platforms like Stripe and PayPal unavailable, the need for a robust solution is urgent. The good news is that blockchain-based payment systems can fill this gap and empower creators to sell digital products seamlessly, without the limitations of conventional payment methods. By harnessing tools like NOWPayments and utilizing the powerful infrastructure of Cloudflare, you can establish an effective online store that accepts payments in cryptocurrency, ensuring that geographic barriers do not hinder your success.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a fully operational online store using the Sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-step-step-14|How to]]er Stack from COREMERCH. This stack leverages GitHub Pages for free hosting and integrates with NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency transactions automatically. By deploying this stack, you will gain the ability to sell your digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and software, while retaining [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-6|COREMERCH guide to complete]] ownership of your data. This immediate action allows you to bypass the limitations posed by unavailable payment gateways in Cameroon and start generating revenue from your digital creations.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack for Cameroon consists of GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend operations, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. This setup ensures that you can accept payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee of less than $0.10. By combining these tools, you can create a streamlined digital commerce experience that is not reliant on traditional banking systems or payment platforms that restrict access to creators in your region. This infrastructure is designed to give you sovereignty over your sales process.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on deploying only the essential components of your digital commerce stack. Avoid getting bogged down by advanced features or integrations that are not critical at this stage. Instead, prioritize setting up your store with a simple product catalog and payment processing capabilities. Once you have established a functioning store, you can iterate and enhance your setup. The key is to move quickly and start generating sales while you refine and expand your offerings, thus maximizing your time and resources.
Blockchain payment infrastructure empowers creators in Cameroon to sell without barriers.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, follow these steps: Deploy your stack using GitHub Pages, load your products, and connect your NOWPayments account. Ensure that your payment methods are configured correctly, allowing customers to check out easily. Once everything is set up, share your store link with your audience to start driving traffic. Monitor payment confirmations through the NOWPayments webhook to ensure a smooth transaction process. This rapid execution will transform your digital product concept into a reality, allowing you to operate independently of traditional barriers.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, you should finalize your product listings and complete the necessary configurations for your payment gateway. Share your store with your network and encourage early purchases to validate your setup. Additionally, begin planning your marketing strategy to reach a broader audience. Leverage social media and local digital communities to promote your offerings. This proactive approach will not only help you generate sales quickly but will also position you as a pioneer among creators in Cameroon.

Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
